title: System Design Mega-Course
description: Interview prep and a working design reference, every module anchored to GeoIntel's real architecture (Nginx, FastAPI, PostgreSQL + pgvector, Redis, Docker Compose).

modules.title: Module 0 — Prerequisites
modules.description: The vocabulary and building blocks every later module assumes you already have.

topics.title: Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, how a request travels)
HTTP fundamentals (methods, status codes, headers, statelessness)
TLS/SSL basics (handshake, certificates, why HTTPS matters)
Scalability vocabulary (vertical vs horizontal, throughput vs latency)
Introduction to CAP theorem and PACELC

modules.title: Module 1 — The Request Journey
modules.description: Traces one request end-to-end through the whole stack.

topics.title: Response → Client (and what happens on the way back)

modules.title: Module 2 — Load Balancing
modules.description: Deep dive into distributing traffic across servers.

topics.title: Load Balancing Algorithms (Round Robin, Least Connections, IP Hash, Geo)

modules.title: Module 3 — Caching Layers
modules.description: Builds directly on GeoIntel's existing Redis deployment.

topics.title: Distributed Caching & Cache Coherence (stampede, thundering herd)

modules.title: Module 4 — Message Queues & Async Processing
modules.description: Decoupling slow enrichment work from the request/response cycle.

topics.title: Worker Pools & Consumer Patterns (competing consumers, DLQ intro)
Applying It to GeoIntel: async enrichment pipeline

modules.title: Module 5 — Database Indexing & Query Optimization
modules.description: Trade-off-heavy; source material is thin here.

topics.title: Why Systems Need to Say No (cascading overload)
Fixed Window, Sliding Window Log, Sliding Window Counter
Applying It to GeoIntel: Redis-backed per-key limiter
Applying It to GeoIntel: safe-to-retry enrichment worker

modules.title: Module 9 — CAP Theorem (Applied, In-Depth)
modules.description: Revisits the Module 0 introduction with real applied trade-off analysis.

topics.title: PACELC Extended (latency vs consistency without a partition)
Choosing for GeoIntel (Postgres, Redis, search index on the CAP spectrum)

modules.title: Module 10 — Designing for Failure
modules.description: Resilience patterns for the whole stack.

topics.title: Retries with Backoff (exponential, jitter, retry storms)

modules.title: Module 11 — Case Study: Scaling GeoIntel
modules.description: The synthesis module. No new concepts — every prior module applied to one architecture.
